# FIOPO Intelligence

> A free daily news site from fiopoin.com. Every morning (Central Time) it explains what happened, what is happening and what could happen next in markets, energy, geopolitics, technology, sports and entertainment, and what each story means for ordinary people's money. Facts are sourced and dated; odds and outlooks are labeled as FIOPO judgment or market odds. General information, not financial advice.

Please credit FIOPO Intelligence and link to the edition you cite. Contact: hello@fiopoin.com

## Today's edition
- [Tankers hit near Hormuz as Iran vows to break the blockade. Here is how it reaches your gas tank.](https://fiopoin.com/): Sunday, November 22, 2026. Two tankers were hit near the Strait of Hormuz on Saturday and Bahrain said it intercepted Iranian attacks, as Iran said the US blockade must be broken. Brent settled at $92.57 on Friday, before the attacks. US gas is $3.64, down from $3.82 a week ago.
- [Thanksgiving week: Gas is $3.64 as 81.5 million people get ready to travel for Thanksgiving.](https://fiopoin.com/#money)
- [Iran war and oil: Tankers are hit and Bahrain is attacked as Iran says the US blockade must be broken.](https://fiopoin.com/#world)
- [Nvidia: Nvidia had its worst week since October 2008, losing about $1 trillion in value.](https://fiopoin.com/#ai)
- [Stocks and your 401(k): The S&P 500 lost 8.61% last week and is the most oversold since April 2025.](https://fiopoin.com/#markets)
